body:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As an Applied AI Engineer on the Commercial team at Anthropic, you will be a trusted technical advisor to the companies that run the real economy, across software, financial services, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, and professional services, as they go from using Claude to building on it. Commercial is one of Anthropic's largest and fastest-moving books of business, covering thousands of mid-market and small companies. Some of these companies put Claude inside the product they sell, and others put agents to work inside their own engineering, operations, finance, and support teams, and this role works with both. You'll lead deep technical engagements, partnering directly with customer engineering teams to take their hardest agent builds from idea to production on the Claude API, the Agent SDK, Claude Managed Agents, Claude Code, and Claude for Enterprise. Many of these teams are lean, with years of existing systems and no dedicated AI function, and you will bridge the gap between what Claude can do and what it takes to run it inside a business that already has customers depending on it.

Working closely with Applied AI Architects, Account Executives, and Anthropic's Product, Engineering, and Research teams, you'll go deep where hands-on engineering changes the outcome, then turn what you learn into something the rest of the book can use. You'll leverage your AI engineering expertise to develop custom evaluation frameworks, design scalable architectures, and create the reference implementations, tooling, and technical resources that enable Commercial customers to succeed with Claude.

Responsibilities

• Serve as a deep technical advisor to high-potential Commercial customers, whether Claude sits inside the product they sell or inside the way they run their own business, bringing them use cases worth building and pushing the boundaries of what agents can do in engineering, operations, finance, customer support, and more

• Work hands-on with customer engineering teams through build sprints, pair programming, and architecture reviews that move agents from idea to production, and understand their stack, data, and workflows end to end so that your guidance fits the systems, security requirements, and team they have today

• Ship working code. Develop prototypes, near-production examples, and technical documentation, including evaluation suites that become the customer's acceptance criteria, AI engineering techniques, and architecture diagrams, that enable customers to build, operate, and scale with Claude

• Create reference implementations, blueprints, and sample code that many companies can adopt without starting from scratch, for example multi-agent systems on the Agent SDK or Claude Managed Agents, MCP servers for common business systems, or Claude Code running across the software development lifecycle

• Collaborate closely with Applied AI Architects and Account Executives to decide where engineering depth changes the outcome, and to maintain context and continuity across customer engagements

• Identify patterns across engagements, including what is hard about running agents inside established companies such as legacy systems, messy data, permissions and security review, cost and latency at scale, and model migrations, then build repeatable evaluations and solutions and contribute insights back to Product, Engineering, Research, and the broader Applied AI team

• Build the demos, agents, and internal tooling that scale the Commercial Applied AI team itself, and pair with architects on their hardest technical problems

• Create technical content for customer and partner engineering audiences including documentation, tutorials, and sample code

• Foster community engagement through hackathons, webinars, technical office hours, and customer events

• Travel to customer sites for workshops, implementation guidance, and relationship building

You may be a good fit if you have

• Deep software engineering experience, gained by designing, building, and operating production systems, along with strong opinions of your own about how to bridge the gap between what AI can do today and how established companies get work done

• 4+ years of technical experience as a software engineer, forward deployed engineer, ML engineer, product engineer, or technical founder, with production experience building LLM-powered applications, including prompting, context engineering, agent architectures, MCP, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale, and the ability to work in a real codebase in Python or TypeScript, not just notebooks

• A systems mindset and comfort with ambiguity. You'd rather build one thing that serves ten customers than ten things that serve one each, and you have a track record of building structure where the playbook doesn't exist yet

• Strong technical communication skills, with the presence to earn the trust of a customer's engineering leaders, the ability to translate complex AI concepts into architectural decisions and actionable implementation plans for both technical and business audiences, and the ability to run technical workshops, hackathons, or developer-focused events

• A collaborative approach to working across teams, the range of a generalist who can context-switch from a fintech to a hospital network to a manufacturer and get up to speed on a new business quickly, and a passion for making powerful technology safe and beneficial

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$280,000 — $320,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

About the Role

N26 is seeking an analytical, regulatory-minded Complaints Compliance & Prevention Manager (Regulatory Project Manager) to lead compliance governance, audit remediation, and the preventive control framework within our Complaints Management & Prevention department. Reporting directly to the head of the department, you will own the end-to-end planning and execution of our regulatory remediation roadmap, separating administrative control and preventive functions from operational case handling. In this role, you will establish a robust, BaFin-compliant preventive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) framework and oversee CMP's Written Orders (SfO) to ensure full operational integrity, data quality, and compliance across all active N26 markets.The role combines a compliance mindset with deep understanding of operations specificity.

What You Will Do

•
Regulatory Remediation & Governance: Lead the end-to-end delivery of the regulatory remediation roadmap, managing Test of Design (ToD) and Test of Effectiveness (ToE) milestones in alignment with BaFin MaBeschwer, MaComp, MaRisk, and general KWG expectations.

•
Preventive Framework & RCA: Build, govern, and scale the preventive RCA framework (MaBeschwer Tz. 18), establishing risk-based selection triggers beyond volume (e.g., PSD2, WpHG, financial loss, reputational risk) to eliminate systematic product and process defects.

•
Written Order (SfO) Ownership: Maintain, update, and own CMP’s Written Orders, procedures, and work instructions for structural compliance, process consistency, and cross-market operational alignment.

•
Control Function & Stakeholder Interface: Serve as the primary operational contact for 2LoD (Compliance, Risk Management), 3LoD (Internal Audit), and external regulatory stakeholders.

•
Team Leadership & Performance: Direct and mentor Associate/Specialist team members in the matrix structure and cross-functional alignment with Product, Tech (PTX), Legal, and CS.

What You Will Bring

•
Minimal requirements:

•
5+ years of proven experience in compliance controls, assurance, banking operations or complaints management in German financial space,

•
full working proficiency in German language.

•
Background & Experience: Professional experience in banking operations, regulatory compliance, or audit remediation, with at least 2+ years leading people or major workstreams within complaint management or dispute resolution in a regulated financial institution.

•
Regulatory Expertise: Deep knowledge of European and German banking regulations, including MaBeschwer, MaComp BT 12, MaRisk AT 4.3.4 / AT 7.1, and PSD2 Article 101.

•
Project & Risk Leadership: Proven track record of executing complex regulatory remediations, implementing internal control systems (ICS), and managing cross-functional projects.

•
Senior Management Exposure: Experience in communicating with senior stakeholders, addressing their requests, and comfortable interacting across all levels of the organisation.

•
Data & Technical Literacy: Understanding of the cases processing technology, customer interfaces, and ticketing platform, as well as operation indicators.

•
Languages: Professional fluency in English and German.

What’s in it for you:

• Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most innovative banks 🚀.

• Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.

• As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.

• Vacation days vary depending on your location of work. Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.

• A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses.

• A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are
N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.
We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.
We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Madrid and Barcelona, and a 1,700-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

Sounds good? Apply now for this position.
Do you see yourself thriving in this role? We’d love to see your application even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles!

Equal opportunities for all
At N26, we believe our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring. We strive to build diverse teams that drive innovation and business success. We actively seek talent from all backgrounds and welcome applications from all genders, cultures, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages.
We are committed to providing an excellent and accessible candidate experience. If you require any accommodations to make this process work for you, please let us know. We’re here to support you!
Discover more about Diversity & Inclusion at N26: https://n26.com/en-eu/diversity-and-inclusion

summary: Staff Brand Designer at Monzo. Location: London, United Kingdom. Monzo is on the VisaJobs known-sponsor list. This posting does not itself state visa sponsorship. Salary: GBP 98000–114000 per year.
body:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍 London | 💰 £98,000 - £114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance | Benefits | Hear from the team ✨

⭐ Our Design team

We’re a team of 115+ designers, researchers and brand experts led by Chief Design Officer Vuokko Aro. We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

Our brand helps make Monzo recognisable and human, whether someone is opening the app, visiting our website or seeing a campaign for the first time. As we grow, there’s a big opportunity to evolve how our brand shows up and make those experiences feel connected.

We’re looking for a Staff Brand Designer to help shape the future of Monzo’s visual identity, lead and develop designers, and set a high bar for creative work across the company.

You’ll join our digital-first internal creative studio and work closely with our Global Creative Director, designers and writers. You’ll also partner with teams across Product Design and Marketing, as well as external agencies, to bring ambitious ideas to life.

This is for a designer who loves getting into the detail as much as shaping the bigger picture and helping others grow. You’ll bring strong conceptual thinking, art direction and typography to your work, and support a team of designers to do their best work too.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by…

• Shaping our creative direction. Work with the Global Creative Director and partners across Monzo to evolve our visual identity and set a clear strategic direction for how the brand shows up globally.

• Leading ambitious work. You’ll lead projects from idea to delivery and oversee work led by others, helping the team solve problems and deliver their best work. You’ll spot opportunities, create briefs and bring the right people together to make ideas happen. You’ll thrive working across multiple projects and teams at once.

• Creating standout design. You’ll lead by example, setting a high bar for craft, concept and execution across the team. You’ll bring ideas to life across campaigns, marketing, product and other brand touch points, inspiring others through the quality of your work.

• Managing and developing designers. Lead and support a small team of designers, helping them grow through regular feedback, coaching and career development conversations. Use Monzo’s levelling frameworks to support their progression and set clear expectations.

• Raising the bar across the team. Lead critiques, share thoughtful feedback and mentor designers beyond your direct reports. Help create the conditions for people to do their best work.

• Connecting brand and product. Partner with Product Design teams to bring Monzo’s brand to life in the app, including developing visual concepts, art direction and motion storyboards for customer experiences.

• Evolving our brand systems. Develop guidelines, design principles and reusable assets that help teams create consistent, distinctive work as Monzo grows.

• Influencing decisions across teams. Bring people together around a creative vision, explain the thinking behind your work and navigate trade-offs between customer needs, creative ambition and business goals.

• Working with creative partners. Collaborate with external agencies and specialists, providing clear direction and feedback to make sure their work feels right for Monzo.

• Improving how we work. Spot opportunities to make our creative process more effective, whether that’s through new tools, better ways of working or clearer guidance for teams.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

• You have a strong portfolio of brand design and campaign work, showing how you’ve developed distinctive creative ideas and brought them to life across different channels.

• You’re an expert in your craft, with particular strength in typography, visual identity and art direction . You care about the details and can show how they make the overall work stronger.

• You have experience managing and developing designers , including giving feedback, supporting career growth and helping people do their best work.

• You’ve led complex creative projects from brief to delivery, making decisions, bringing people with you and maintaining a high standard throughout.

• You can think beyond a single project: you’ve helped shape a brand’s direction, developed design systems or guidelines, or improved how creative work happens across a team or organisation.

• You’re comfortable working with ambiguity. You can define a direction, navigate competing priorities and make thoughtful trade-offs without losing sight of the bigger picture.

• You’re proactive, creating your own briefs, bringing the right people together to accomplish your goals. You’re not just a doer, but a problem solver and a self-starter.

• You enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, working across multiple teams and projects at the same time.

• You’re a confident collaborator who can explain and advocate for your ideas with designers, cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders.

• You enjoy raising the quality of design beyond your own work, through mentoring, critique and sharing what you know.

• You’re highly proficient in Figma and comfortable using the tools you need to develop and deliver your ideas. You have a clear interest in AI tools and are keen to explore and use them to evolve how we work and what we create across design, marketing and product.

• You have experience working in a digital-first brand, creative agency or in-house team, and can show how your work has supported customer or business goals.

• You can develop ideas for motion and communicate them through storyboards or creative direction. You don’t need to be a motion specialist.

We’d also love to see experience across areas such as web design, campaigns, print, film, illustration or 3D. You don’t need to be an expert in all of them.

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £98,000 - £114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We’ll set you up to work from home. All employees are given a MacBook.

➕ Plus lots more! Take a look at our benefits .

🌈 The application journey

• 30-minute call with our Recruiter

• 1-hour craft interview where you’ll present a single case study to 2 members of our Brand Design team.

• 1-hour interview covering values & ways of working.

To be considered for this role you will need to include your CV and a portfolio showcasing your work. This will allow us to better understand your experience. We’d particularly love to see projects you’ve led from start to finish, including the thinking behind the work, the impact it had and your individual contribution.

We have some guidelines on using AI to support your application and interviews at Monzo. You can read them here .

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.

#LI-TR1

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog , 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

body:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

As a Strategic Pursuits Lead at Anthropic, you will operate as an elite individual contributor running our largest and most complex enterprise pursuits end-to-end. You will serve as the strategic quarterback for high-stakes engagements with Fortune 100 companies and global institutions, owning the C-suite relationships and discussions each pursuit demands while working hand in hand with the account team and field leadership who own the account. That ownership is an and, not an or, and the pursuit only works when both are true. You will coordinate across product, research, partnerships, legal, and executive leadership, and architect bespoke solutions that unlock transformational business value. When the agreement is signed, you will hand the account back in a healthy state, with the account team positioned to execute what was signed and a playbook behind you. This role reports directly to the Head of Strategic Pursuits.

Responsibilities

•
Lead end-to-end orchestration of Anthropic’s most strategic and complex enterprise pursuits.

•
Own the C-suite relationships and discussions on each pursuit, in full partnership with the account team and field leadership who own the account

•
Design and execute sophisticated account strategies that position Claude as mission-critical infrastructure for enterprise transformation

•
Navigate intricate multi-stakeholder decision processes across technical, business, legal, security, and procurement functions

•
Partner with product and research teams to shape custom solutions and influence roadmap priorities for strategic accounts

•

🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. • Taking ownership of the preparation, analysis and submission of regulatory reporting requirements (e.g. Capital, Liquidity)

• Ensuring compliance with the applicable regulatory interpretations

• Assisting the wider team in producing Monzo’s capital and liquidity regulatory reporting and disclosures (including Pillar 3)

• Executing and improving the controls required to ensure regulatory reporting is timely, accurate and complete

• Ensuring high data quality by performing data profiling and investigating data quality issues

• Using data visualisation tools to build dashboards and facilitate sign-off and useful insights

• Partnering with teams internally to help them make informed business decisions and providing input into new product launches

• Designing brilliant ways to automate your work and leverage technology to ensure we scale with the business

🤩We’d love to hear from you if…

• You have a good understanding of capital requirements, liquidity reports and regulatory frameworks

• You’re excited by data and have a sharp eye for detail

• You have knowledge of coding languages (SQL would be a bonus), although a willingness to learn is just fine

• You have strong analytical skills, high attention to detail and the ability to meet tight deadlines

• You want to automate or enhance recurring processes, particularly by leveraging technology, and implement changes in collaboration with IT and regulatory change teams.

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £56,100 - £64,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance

📍 This role is based in our London office, with a hybrid working approach

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits .

🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps:

• Phone call with recruiter

• Initial call with hiring manager (30 mins)

• Technical interview with hiring manager and team member (45 mins)

• Monzo behavioural interview (45 min)

This process should take around 3 - 4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.

You can read more in our blog , 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

This is a chance to help build and shape EMEA partner marketing from the ground up, including how the function works.

body:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰£78,000 - £100,000 + Benefits | 12 month fixed term contract

The Integrated Marketing Lead will develop and deliver marketing campaigns that support Monzo Business's growth ambitions. You'll bring together marketing channels, product launches and commercial partnerships to drive customer acquisition, engagement and business value, working closely with teams across Marketing and Business Banking.

This is a 12-month fixed-term contract.

⭐️ Capabilities

• Cross-functional leadership: Ability to bring together Marketing centers of excellence, Product, Sales and commercial partners to deliver coordinated B2B campaigns and shared business outcomes.

• Strategic thinking & B2B expertise: Strong understanding of business customer segments, buying behaviors and go-to-market approaches, with the ability to apply B2B marketing best practices to commercial opportunities.

• Commercial acumen in marketing: Understanding of B2B marketing economics, customer acquisition, engagement and lifetime value, with the ability to prioritize investment and resources based on business impact.

• Integrated campaign design: Expertise in developing and delivering multi-channel campaigns and product launches, connecting customer insight, proposition, messaging and channels across the buying journey.

• Performance and measurement: Ability to use data and customer insights to evaluate marketing effectiveness, understand funnel performance, test new approaches and improve business outcomes.

🔑 What you’ll be doing:

• Develop and deliver marketing plans and campaigns that support Business Banking's commercial priorities and wider go-to-market strategy.

• Own the planning and execution of priority campaigns, product launches and commercial partnerships, coordinating teams across Marketing, Product and the wider business.

• Translate customer and market insights into effective audience strategies, channel plans and customer journeys.

• Manage campaign budgets, timelines, resources and dependencies, making recommendations on where to focus effort and investment.

• Work with commercial partners on joint marketing initiatives, coordinating plans, managing relationships and measuring results.

• Monitor campaign performance, share results with stakeholders and identify opportunities to improve commercial outcomes.

• Contribute B2B marketing expertise, new ideas and external best practices to strengthen our go-to-market approach.

• Explore how AI and new technologies can improve campaign planning, execution and measurement, challenging existing ways of working.

🤩 You’ll love this role if you:

• Have a strong track record in B2B marketing, delivering campaigns and product launches targeting SMEs that have driven measurable commercial results.

• Understand different B2B go-to-market approaches, including self-serve acquisition and how marketing works with Sales to reach and convert businesses.

• Have experience working across Marketing, Product and commercial teams, including managing external partners and agencies.

• Are comfortable managing budgets, using performance data and making decisions based on customer and commercial impact.

• Bring fresh thinking and a strong point of view on what great B2B marketing looks like, with the curiosity to keep learning and improving.

• Actively use AI in your work and enjoy experimenting with new tools and approaches to improve how marketing gets done.

• Can balance strategic thinking with hands-on delivery, managing competing priorities and getting things done.

A bit about you:

• ​You think strategically, but you’re not afraid to get hands-on.

• ​You understand how to prioritise when there’s a lot to juggle

• ​You bring people together and know how to get them excited about the work.

• You care about doing the right thing for customers and for the business.

• You’re humble and curious, asking for help when you need it and you’re always looking for ways to do things better.

🌈 The Interview Process (for successful applicants)

Our interview process involves three main stages:

• Initial Call (30mins)

• Case Study Presentation (45mins)

• x2 final interviews via Google Meet (45mins for each interview)

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

You’ll hear from us throughout the application process, but if you’ve got any questions, please reach out to hiring@monzo.com. You can also use this email address to let us know if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you because of disability, neurodiversity or anything else.

🙌 What’s in it for you:

💰 £78,000 - £100,000

📍This role will be based out of our London office next to Liverpool Street station in a hybrid approach of office based and home working, or remotely within the UK

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

📚 Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences

See our full list of benefits here

⏳ We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.

#LI-CM1 #LI-REMOTE

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. About the role

Anthropic is investing $50 billion in American computing infrastructure, including datacenters custom-built for our workloads, and this role sits at the heart of that effort. As a Staff Engineer on the Datacenter Server Lifecycle team, you will own the end-to-end operational journey of every machine in our datacenters – from initial provisioning and deployment, steady-state operation, maintenance, and repair.

This is greenfield work: you will help define the services, tooling, standards and processes that govern how we operate critical hardware at scale, powering frontier model development and serving. You will have the opportunity to define AI-native workflows for datacenter operations and to help drive innovations on efficiency, performance, and reliability.

A distinguishing aspect of this role is its deep intersection with security. The machines in our datacenter handle some of the most sensitive workloads in AI – training frontier models and serving millions of users interacting with Claude. Ensuring that every machine in the fleet is trusted, attested, and operating with a verified chain of integrity from the hardware up is a core part of the job, not an afterthought. You will partner closely with our Infrastructure Security team to define and enforce trusted compute standards across the lifecycle, from secure provisioning through end-of-life handling.

Key responsibilities

• Build automation to support datacenter fleets at scale.

• Define and own the end-to-end system lifecycle strategy – from provisioning and deployment through operation, maintenance, refresh, and decommissioning – and maintain automation and operational procedures for common lifecycle events (e.g., hardware failures, firmware upgrades, fleet rotations).

• Partner closely with Infrastructure Security to design and enforce trusted compute standards across the server lifecycle.

• Work closely with our Networking team to ensure end-to-end connectivity across all sites.

• Build and maintain tooling to track machine health, configuration, and operational status across the full datacenter fleet.

Minimum qualifications

• Hands-on experience with server hardware, including rack deployment, cabling, troubleshooting, and understanding failure modes at scale.

• End-to-end understanding of hardware lifecycle management: asset tracking, provisioning workflows, maintenance scheduling, and decommissioning practices.

• Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Rust, Go, or Java).

• Working knowledge of modern cloud infrastructure, including Kubernetes and large scale cloud providers (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP).

• Ability to communicate clearly and build consensus with a wide range of stakeholders.

• Comfort navigating ambiguity and making progress on complex, cross-functional problems.

• Willingness to travel occasionally to datacenter sites across North America.

Preferred qualifications

• 8+ years of experience in datacenter infrastructure management, or a closely related discipline.

• Hands-on experience with GPU or AI accelerator hardware (e.g., NVIDIA A100/H100, Google TPUs, or AWS Trainium) and an understanding of their operational demands.

• Familiarity with modern provisioning and OS tooling such as LinuxBoot and NixOS

• Experience building or contributing to datacenter automation or fleet management platforms.

• Experience building and deploying server operating system distributions across large server fleets.

• Background in large-scale capacity planning and hardware refresh strategy, ideally at a hyperscaler or large cloud provider.

• Experience with trusted compute and hardware security concepts such as secure boot, TPM, hardware attestation, and firmware verification — or a strong desire to develop deep expertise in this area.

You'll own the information architecture, the content, and the overall experience of platform.claude.com/docs — from a developer's first quickstart to the reference page they keep open in a pinned tab.

This role sits on the DevX team and is closer to DevRel than to traditional technical writing. The job is taste, judgment, and end-to-end developer empathy in addition to strong writing skills: you'll be expected to build with the Claude API yourself, understand the product firsthand, and turn that understanding into documentation developers genuinely love.

•
Set and hold the quality bar for every page on platform.claude.com/docs — clarity, correctness, completeness, voice

You've been the end-to-end owner (not just a contributor) of a developer-facing surface like docs, SDKs, quickstarts, or a content program: setting a quality bar, holding it without being chased, and saying no to things that don't meet it

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Our team builds, tests, deploys, and monitors the classifiers that block internal agents from taking dangerous actions. These classifiers run across RL, evals, and internal deployments, and are designed to catch things like sandbox escape attempts or exfiltration of sensitive data.

When a classifier flags an action, it can block the action before the tool call runs, end the task, and alert a human . This is one layer of a defence-in-depth with several layers that reinforce each other: what our classifiers flag feeds into offline monitoring, and the findings from that go back into better classifiers and safer environment design.

The work combines research and production engineering:

•
The research problem is building high recall and high precision classifiers to catch rare, novel, and sometimes adversarial behaviour. There are also several narrow research questions to answer - for example, how to deploy safety classifiers inside training environments without incentivising models to evade them. Some research also builds on the multi-stage designs described in our work on Claude Code auto mode and Constitutional Classifiers .

•
The engineering problem is shipping these classifiers into the critical path of research and product work. These classifiers need to cover a huge volume of traffic while operating within cost, latency and availability constraints.

Day to day, much of our work is done with Claude: you'll direct agents to run experiments and ship code, and review what they produce. That moves the hard part of the job towards deciding what to do and in what order. Additionally, organisation, communication, and prioritisation skills matter a great deal as our classifiers sit in the path of many other teams' work.

Key responsibilities

•
Design, train, and evaluate classifiers that detect unsafe agent actions in real time, owning pieces such as prompted models, trained classifiers, or probes on model internals

•

•
Build the datasets, labelling pipelines, and evaluations that allow us to measure and improve our classifiers and harm taxonomies

•
Partner with red teaming colleagues to stress-test our classifiers, and harden them against what they find

•

•
Experience building detection systems where true positives are rare and false positives are costly, such as abuse, fraud, spam, or intrusion detection

•

•
Background in security, such as sandboxing or detection and response

Familiarity with research on AI control, scalable oversight, agent safety, or reinforcement learning

We’ve started building a sales team and testing a more personal approach. Now we’re looking for a Sales Manager to lead a team of Account Executives and help us turn what we’re learning into a repeatable, effective sales motion.

This is a chance to build something new. You’ll coach your team, help them deliver great results and use what you see every day to make the way we sell better. You’ll work closely with Revenue Operations (RevOps), Product and other teams to improve our processes and customer journeys.

You’ll also help build an AI-first sales motion from the start. We want someone who’s curious about AI and automation, actively experiments with new tools and can help the team spend more time on conversations that matter.

body:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic exists to ensure the world safely navigates the transition through transformative AI. That work is funded by commercial revenue — and every dollar of it runs through Billing Platform. We build and operate the infrastructure that turns product usage into revenue across everything Anthropic ships: Claude.ai, the Developer Platform, Claude Code, and all that comes next. The faster we can price it, charge for it, and account for it correctly, the faster Anthropic can fund the mission.

Pricing Foundations is the team within Billing that turns a signed enterprise agreement into something every system can act on. We own the model and the systems of record for what a customer bought: their commitments, their pricing terms, how many organizations roll up to one agreement, and the automation that provisions a signed deal across Anthropic's products and the cloud platforms where Claude is sold. When a deal closes, our systems decide what the customer is entitled to, what they pay, and what Finance reports.

We're looking for an engineering manager to lead this team. You'll hire and grow the team, set its technical direction, and own how it delivers. Success looks like new deal structures shipping as configuration rather than one-off engineering, and signed deals provisioning automatically, with the rare exception routed to someone who can fix it.

Key responsibilities

• Lead and grow the team. Hire, coach, and develop engineers, give clear and honest feedback, and build a team that owns its domain end to end.

• Own the commercial data model. Set the direction for how commitments, pricing terms, account hierarchies, and entitlements are modeled, so a new deal structure extends the model instead of working around it.

• Own the pricing primitives: the catalog of products and rates, and the constructs that let contracted pricing follow a customer across products and new model launches.

• Make the contract the source of truth. Build systems of record that Finance can close the books on and trace back to the signed contract, with reconciliation against the CRM and every downstream billing system designed in from the start.

• Automate the path from signature to a live customer. Lead the durable workflows that provision a signed deal across Anthropic's products and the cloud platforms where Claude is sold, recover from partial failure, and route exceptions to the right person with the context to resolve them.

• Build for people and agents. Own the interfaces for agreements, entitlements, and pricing terms that seller tools and Claude-powered agents read and write, so both get the same safe, auditable capabilities.

• Own planning and delivery. Turn competing asks from Sales, Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, and product teams into a clear roadmap, make the trade-offs explicit, and hold the team to its milestones.

• Operate what you ship. Set SLOs on the flows your team runs, instrument them so discrepancies surface before month-end close, and keep on-call sustainable as volume grows.

Minimum qualifications

• 8+ years of industry experience, including 3+ years leading software engineering teams including hiring, coaching and performance management.

• A strong background building production backend systems, with enough depth in a language such as Go, Python, or Java to review designs and code.

• Experience leading teams that built billing, payments, pricing, contract management, or other financial systems of record in production.

• Experience modeling transactional or financial data, including relational databases and SQL.

• Experience leading teams that built and operated asynchronous, long-running workflows, such as on a durable workflow engine like Temporal or on queues and state machines.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience building CPQ, contract management, or quote-to-cash platforms, and firsthand knowledge of how one change to pricing terms ripples through quoting, provisioning, invoicing, and revenue reporting.

• Experience with enterprise commercial structures such as multi-year or ramped commitments, drawdowns, amendments and renewals, or one agreement shared across many accounts.

• Experience integrating or extending third-party billing, payment, or CRM platforms, and opinions on where they fall short.

• Experience building revenue reconciliation or financial reporting pipelines, or systems that had to pass a financial audit.

• Experience automating a high-touch operational process and measuring the manual work it removed.

• Experience building LLM-powered tools or agents, or systems designed for agents to call safely.

• Experience growing a team through a period of rapid company growth.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$405,000 — $485,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Experience leading the design and delivery of complex, user-facing products across the full stack, through requirements that shifted while you built.

Experience designing for correctness and data integrity from the start, in systems where errors are costly and hard to undo.

We are seeking a Partner Marketing Lead, APAC, reporting to the Global Head of Partner Marketing, to own partner marketing end to end across a region where partners are central to how Claude reaches enterprises. As our founding APAC Partner Marketing leader, you'll set the plan for the region rather than execute one set elsewhere: you'll build the operating model, carry partner pipeline goals, and turn our work with hyperscale cloud providers, global and regional systems integrators, resellers, and technology partners into a regional go-to-market motion that creates pipeline and drives adoption of Claude.

The central challenge is sequencing: ANZ, ASEAN, India, Japan, and Korea differ in their partner ecosystems, buyers, languages, and maturity. In some, local partners are the main route to enterprise customers, and India's systems integrators also deliver for customers worldwide. You'll decide where to invest first, where a global or partner-led program is enough for now, and where to wait.

This role calls for the seniority to lead a regional organization and the willingness to start hands-on with a very small team, defining the regional team plan and then hiring and managing the team as headcount opens. The role covers the whole region, including Japan, where you'll build on an established Partner Marketing presence, so that partners and sales teams experience one connected regional approach.

• Experience leading marketing with cloud providers, systems integrators, and resellers or distributors, including owning the pipeline that came from that work

• Experience marketing AI/ML or other complex technical products to enterprises

body:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London / UK Remote | 💰£142,000 - £170,000 + Benefits ✨

Our Financial Control team ⭐

We are seeking an experienced finance operations leader for a 12-month fixed-term contract to lead our Global Financial Operations and Control team. The incumbent Director is stepping out of day-to-day operations to spearhead a strategic, multi-year finance automation and systems program.

Your mandate is to provide steady-state operational leadership across all financial operations, close cycles, and management reporting; and serve as the essential operational contact for the program. You will ensure BAU integrity while actively operationalising and absorbing newly automated processes.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

• Leading all aspects of financial control and operations, including Accounts Payable, Treasury Operations/Product Control, Money Operations ensuring robust, well controlled, and timely transaction processing.

• Leading the production and end-to-end delivery of monthly close and management reporting cycle, working across Finance to provide the Group Financial Controller, UK CFO and EU CFOs with actionable insights and variance analysis.

• Maintaining a robust, control and governance framework focused on integrity of our data and processes.

• Serving as the primary operational counterpart and sounding board to the Director of Financial Operations & Control (incumbent) within the programme, providing operational feedback on target operating models and workflow designs.

• Managing team capacity and workflows to free up key subject matter experts for involvement in the programme, including (not limited to) User Acceptance Testing, parallel runs, and systems testing.

• Supporting the practical change management and operational rollout of new automation tools within the live environment, establishing new standard operating procedures without interrupting daily processing.

• Working closely with the Director of Financial & Regulatory Reporting to ensure core financial operations and control processes comply with overarching accounting policies and provide a seamless hand off into the consolidation.

• Providing stable, empathetic, and accountable leadership to a distributed team during a period of change, maintaining high engagement, retention, and performance.

• Building and maintaining effective working relationships with internal stakeholders, external auditors and advisors.

• Driving the delivery of the Financial Operations and Control teams milestones and actions on existing key projects such as EU expansion, working with stakeholders to identify and resolve delivery risks.

• Managing a structured, documented operational handover back to permanent leadership at the conclusion of the 12-month term.

Role Scope Clarification

• Included: Global financial operations and control process ownership, including delivery of those services to subsidiaries, Treasury operations/Product control, Money Operations, Month-end Close and related management reporting.

• Excluded: Group Consolidation and the preparation/filing of Statutory Financial Statements for the Group and subsidiaries; Regulatory Reporting.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

• You have a demonstrated track record stepping into high volume, multi-entity finance operations leadership roles and delivering immediate stability within regulated environments (Fintech, Banking, or Financial Services preferred).

• You’re an empathetic, effective people leader with a strong track record of coaching individuals and fostering a positive, high-performing environment.

• You have a deep understanding of internal control environments and the ability to build "best-in-class" processes.

• You have experience operating within complex, multi-entity or cross-border structures where data consistency is paramount.

• You have demonstrated experience operationalising new technology, and embedding change within Finance teams.

• Have excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain operational complexities to key stakeholders and peers.

• You are adaptability and resilience in fast-paced, tech-led, and agile environments.

• You hold strong technical accounting knowledge (IFRS)

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £142,000 - £170,000.

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits .

🌈 The application journey has 5 key steps

• Initial Call with the Recruiter

• Hiring Manager Interview

Work with the activation systems and operations lead to turn repeat exceptions and repeat questions into rule changes or automation, so fewer requests need a person each quarter

Use Claude to prepare for pipeline calls, draft follow-ups, and summarize the state of your book, and propose the next manual step worth automating

Work US hours with a regular overlap window with the London-based program lead, and hand off cleanly so Commercial sellers have coverage across time zones

Experience in partner sales, channel, or partner operations in B2B technology

Experience working with services partners or systems integrators: matching them to customer work, judging fit and capacity, and holding them to commitments

About Anthropic

About the role

The Claude Partner Network is how partners build, sell, and deliver on Claude. Partner Support keeps them moving: getting set up, getting certified, registering their work, and understanding where they stand in the program. It runs in layers. Self-serve and an AI support agent handle what they can, an outsourced vendor team works the in-scope (L1) topics, and our specialists take the escalated (L2) cases that need judgment.

As our Partner Support Operations Lead, you will run partner support end to end: the team, the operating model, and the systems behind every layer. Partner Programs sets program policy. You will build and run the service levels, knowledge, quality bar, and escalation paths that put that policy into practice, and keep them reliable as volume grows.

This is a hands-on operator and builder role. You will be close enough to the queue to know why a case was hard or a rule broke, while you build the team, the vendor coverage, and the Claude-powered automation that keep support from growing in line with partner count.

• Manage the partner support team: set priorities and clear expectations, coach the Partner Support Specialists, address performance early, and expand the team if volume or coverage calls for it

• Own the support operating model: the L1 and L2 boundary, severity definitions, service levels, and escalation paths; review misrouted and wrongly escalated tickets, and fix the rule as well as the ticket

• Run the L2 queue to its service levels: coverage across shifts, one owner for every case, clean handoffs to the teams that hold the answer, and careful handling of sensitive and high-impact partner issues

• Scale through self-serve, vendors, and Claude: use topic and outcome data to decide what moves to each, and build automations for tagging, routing, QA screening, and reporting; test them on real tickets and add human checkpoints where a wrong answer carries risk

• Turn what partners ask into fixes: bring the recurring causes behind ticket volume to Partner Programs, Partner Business Systems, and other owners, and follow each one through until the tickets stop

• Run support on a scorecard covering responsiveness, resolution, escalation accuracy, and quality, and use it to plan capacity and to tell the team, the vendor, and leadership what to fix next

Resellers are a major route for organizations to buy Claude. Our reseller program runs across two motions: hyperscaler resale, where partners resell Claude through the cloud marketplaces (AWS Bedrock today, Google Cloud Vertex AI and Microsoft Foundry to follow), and direct resale, where partners resell on Anthropic paper through our own quote-to-order and billing systems. Each motion brings its own agreements, systems and cloud counterparts, and the program is expanding across regions at the same time.

As our Resale Operations Lead, you will run resale operations: how resellers get authorized, transact, get reported on, get paid and get supported, across both motions and every live cloud. The resale business team sets the strategy and the commercial framework. You will build and run the processes, playbooks and team that put that framework into practice, and keep them reliable as volume grows.

This is an operator and builder role, not a partner manager role. You will be hands-on in the detail of a private offer or a partner quote while you build the team, the vendor coverage and the Claude-powered automation that keep resale operations from growing in line with partner count.

•

•
Experience managing outsourced or vendor teams: scope, service levels, quality sampling and performance feedback.

Sound judgment while the program is still moving. You can make the call with incomplete information, hold a control under pressure from sales or a partner, and keep the relationship intact.

A builder's mindset and clear writing. You use tools like Claude to automate your own work, and you document what you build so a new teammate or vendor lead can run it.

Experience on the partner or marketplace side of a hyperscaler, or in operations at a major distributor.

•
Experience running partner rebate, margin or incentive operations, or launching a resale program in EMEA or APAC.

•
Familiarity with the Claude API, Claude Code or MCP.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's products are growing fast in reach and complexity. Every new model, product, and channel brings problems no one predicted. We want to catch each issue as early as possible, get customers unblocked fast, and fix the root cause. The best experience is one where a customer never has to ask for help.

We are building a Support Technology engineering team to solve what stands between a customer and Claude, whether they want to use it but can't or are unhappy with their experience. That covers individual users, businesses, and customers who reach Claude through partners.

Our goal is a better product experience for everyone who uses Claude. We make it easy for customers to get help and talk to us, through Claude itself and via human specialists with the tools to solve their problems. We also determine why they needed help and fix the cause in the product.

Billing is a good example. When a charge is confusing, a payment fails, or a plan doesn't unlock, a customer should be able to reach us and get it resolved in one conversation. Then we want to learn why it happened and change the product, whether that's the subscription flow, the payment error, or the invoice, so the next customer never has to ask.

As one of the team's early engineers, you will set the technical direction and build the core systems behind this work. We expect Claude to handle more of each case over time, from diagnosing an issue to resolving it to flagging the product fix behind it. Success means customers run into fewer problems, get them truly solved when they do, and are happy with the help they receive, whether it comes from Claude or a person.

This is a hands-on role with high leverage. You will write a lot of code and lead across teams, since many fixes belong to other product teams. You will partner with our Product Manager, the Product Support team, and product engineering teams such as Billing Platform.

Key responsibilities

• Improve the product experience at the root: Build agents that spot where customers keep getting stuck and find the root cause, then ship the fix or drive it with the owning team until customers stop running into the problem

• Make our support agents reliable first responders: Build the tools, APIs, and safe, audited workflows our Claude-powered support agents use for common fixes, with evals, guardrails, and clean handoffs to people, and measure whether customers' problems actually get solved

• Build the platform foundations: Create a reliable support platform that scales with our growth, including the experience and tools for customers and specialists, and the data that shows what customers are running into and whether our changes help

• Support enterprise and partner channels: Extend support to business customers, admins, and partner-sold customers, including cases that start outside our own products

• Raise the bar and build with Claude: Set standards for reliability, observability, testing, and rollouts, mentor engineers, and use Claude heavily in your own work

Minimum qualifications

• Deep backend and distributed systems skills, including APIs, data models, event-driven systems, and third-party integrations

• Experience building production software, including technical lead roles on multi-team projects

• Experience building systems where correctness, access control, and auditability matter

• A clear vision for how capable models like Claude can improve customer support, and motivation to build it

• Judgment about when to ship a simple fix and when to invest in a platform

• Track record of leading without formal authority and getting other teams to own and ship fixes

Preferred qualifications

• 8+ years building backend or platform systems in production, including 3+ years leading large-scale, complex projects or teams as an engineer or tech lead

• Experience building and improving customer-facing products with measurable impact

• Experience with billing, payments, or subscription systems

• Experience shipping LLM-based or agentic systems in production

• Experience building with helpdesk or contact center platforms such as Intercom, Zendesk, or Salesforce Service Cloud

• Experience building internal tools or platforms for operations teams such as support, risk, finance, or trust and safety

• Experience building data pipelines for support or operations analytics

• Full-stack experience, including web UIs for internal tools or customer-facing flows

• Experience with enterprise features such as SSO, admin controls, or provisioning, or with partner and cloud marketplace integrations

• Experience setting multi-year technical direction for an area and growing other senior engineers

About the opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager to act as the visionary owner for a major segment vertical, responsible for architecting long-term frameworks that align global customer needs with market-defining value propositions.

Our Senior Product Marketing team steers product evolution and global GTM standards to maximize adoption and ecosystem loyalty, and believes in using deep analytical rigor and strong cross-functional leadership to define the voice of the customer.

In this role, you will serve as the primary strategic bridge between Executive, Product, and Operations teams, ensuring that every launch delivers significant commercial impact and a differentiated competitive edge.

In this role, you will:

• Serve as the Marketing Owner and visionary lead for a major segment vertical, accountable for the long-term strategic framework that aligns global JTBD with a market-defining Value Proposition, while steering the Product Offering evolution and global GTM standards to maximize Product Adoption and ecosystem lock-in

• Partner with the lifecycle team to foster ongoing customer education, deepen continuous product adoption, and maximize long-term user retention

• Craft compelling, consumer-centric value propositions and tailored messaging that clearly differentiate our products within the highly competitive fintech landscape

• Design and implement impactful GTM strategies for new product features and launches, ensuring flawless cross-channel execution and significant user acquisition

• Define, monitor, and analyze key performance metrics for all product launches, proactively adjusting marketing plans to meet or exceed adoption targets

• Champion the voice of the customer by leveraging market research, competitive analysis, and UX feedback to uncover market fit opportunities and refine product narratives

• Collaborate closely with the brand and creative teams to maintain a consistent voice, tone, and high-quality creative standard across all marketing channels

• Act as the strategic bridge between product, business operations, and marketing, aligning stakeholders on priorities and ensuring seamless communication and execution

What you need to be successful:

Background:

• 8+ years of experience within the Product Marketing space ideally in a tech driven company

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or Commerce with relevant experience

Skills:

• Extensive experience leading end-to-end Go-to-Market strategies, serving as the critical bridge between Product, Marketing, and Operations to ensure seamless, high-impact launches

• Proven track record of driving product acquisition, user growth, and retention through strategic lifecycle initiatives and in-product growth levers

• Expert at crafting customer centric value propositions and differentiated messaging that effectively positions products within the competitive fintech or tech landscape.

• Skilled at synthesizing market research, UX insights, and competitive analysis to inform strategy, while maintaining a strong understanding of tech-driven ecosystems and regulatory requirements

• Advanced stakeholder influence and collaboration through building cross functional partnerships and influencing decisions across Product, Marketing, and Business teams in fast paced environments

• Advanced growth mindset with a proactive, high-ownership mentality with bias for action and a commitment to a "test, learn, and optimize" approach based on data insights

What’s in it for you:

• Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.

• Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.

• As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.

• Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.

• A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds.

• A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

Do you see yourself thriving in this role? We’d love to see your application even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles!
