body:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍Dublin, Ireland | 💰€100,000 - €130,000, Incentive Awards tied to your performance➕ benefits

⭐Our Finance team

We are looking for a dynamic Treasury Capital Manager in Dublin to become a key part of the team building the new Monzo European entity. Reporting into the Director of Treasury and Capital, you will shape, develop and implement the Capital management process and infrastructure in tandem with supporting the growth and strategic development of the business. As well as skills and experience in Treasury and Capital Management, the ability to adapt, be creative and work in a fast paced environment with wider Group colleagues will be essential talents as the business grows.

As part of a new and growing team, the Treasury Capital Manager will be responsible for ensuring that Monzo effectively manages its capital and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements in Europe. This is an opportunity to be part of something from the start and make a real difference.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by…

• Lead the planning and production of Monzo Europe’s ICAAP in line with regulatory capital requirements.

• Develop capital plans and forecasts, including stress testing and scenario analysis.

• Lead the planning and implementation work in line with Monzo’s recovery and resolution requirements including the Recovery Plan and Solvent Wind Down Plan.

• Identify the impact of prudential regulatory change and supporting relevant teams to assess and adapt to the challenges.

• Optimise the capital structure and allocation to support growth and strategic objectives.

• Prepare and present regular financial reports and forecasts to senior management.

• Building strong relationships with internal teams such as the business/product collectives to optimize the bank's capital structure and funding strategies.

• Provide operational coverage for the Director of Treasury and Capital during holidays.

🤩We’d love to hear from you if you have…

• A bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related field. A Master’s degree or professional qualification (e.g., CFA, ACA, ACCA) is preferred.

• A minimum of 5 years of experience in Treasury Capital management, within the banking sector, a consultancy, or regulatory body.

• Have detailed knowledge/experience of the European regulatory requirements, and the ability to interpret what that means for the relatively unique circumstances of our bank.

• Have the ability to coordinate, participate and lead projects to produce regulatory deliverables and maintain the Bank’s set of prudential documentation and supporting materials.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

• Strong leadership abilities and experience in working across dispersed teams.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

🙌What’s in it for you

💰A salary range of €100,000 - €130,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 2 - 3 days a week.

⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)

📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏥Private healthcare scheme

💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%

💛Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling

🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps

• An introductory call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team

• An initial call with the hiring manager

• A series of role specific, behavioural & leadership principles interviews

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.

#LI-ÉS1

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog , 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role:

Anthropic is seeking an International Infrastructure Accounting professional to join our Infrastructure Accounting team. Based in Dublin and reporting to the Head of International Infrastructure Accounting, you will execute day-to-day accounting for the leased and owned infrastructure supporting Anthropic's expansion outside the United States, i.e. the data centers, network infrastructure, and compute capacity underpinning our international growth. As we continue our rapid growth, you will help ensure the operational scalability and financial accuracy of the core functions that enable Anthropic's research and commercial success.

This is an opportunity to be at the heart of one of the fastest-scaling companies in the industry, and to shape how Anthropic's growing international infrastructure portfolio is accounted for and understood across the business.

You will own end-to-end accounting for Anthropic's international infrastructure portfolio, with an initial focus on leases, working closely with cross-functional partners across Data Center Operations, Real Estate, Finance, and Legal. You'll apply deep technical accounting expertise under ASC 842 for the US GAAP books, and carry those same arrangements through to the IFRS 16 or local GAAP books. You will partner closely with our central team to ensure global policies, processes, and controls are applied consistently as each new market comes online.

Responsibilities:

•
Lead end-to-end accounting for Anthropic's international infrastructure portfolio — leased and owned, with an initial focus on leases — including monthly close, reconciliations, roll-forwards, and flux analysis

•
Apply technical accounting expertise to complex infrastructure arrangements under ASC 842 (lease classification, measurement, modifications, embedded leases, and reassessments) and ASC 360 (capitalization, useful lives, impairment, and disposals)

•
Prepare the US GAAP to IFRS 16 and local GAAP adjustments for each international entity, and partner with our International Statutory Reporting team and external providers so the statutory accounts are accurate and filed on time

•
Partner with Real Estate, Legal, and Finance teams during contract negotiation and execution to ensure accounting implications are understood before commitments are made

•
Serve as a trusted finance partner to non-finance stakeholders — explaining the financial statement impact of their decisions in clear, simple terms they can act on

•
Apply global infrastructure accounting policies, processes, and controls consistently as each new market comes online

•
Help stand up the accounting foundations for each new market, i.e. entity and chart of accounts mapping, functional currency, intercompany flows, and lease system onboarding

•
Collaborate cross-functionally to improve the quality of upstream data pipelines from operational and contract systems, particularly around contract terms, asset receipt, deployment, and in-service dates

•
Collaborate with and mentor accounting professionals across the Infrastructure Accounting team

•
Serve as a key point of contact with external auditors and local statutory auditors on international infrastructure matters

•
Drive process improvements and automation, including leveraging AI tooling, to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of financial reporting

Minimum Requirements:

•
Have 10+ years of progressive experience in accounting, with operational experience at technology or infrastructure-heavy companies

•
Are a qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CPA, or equivalent) with a bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or equivalent practical experience

•
Possess strong technical accounting knowledge of ASC 842 and ASC 360, particularly as applied to infrastructure, data center, or compute-related arrangements

•
Have worked across both US GAAP and IFRS, and are comfortable owning the differences rather than handing them off

•
Have experience managing a significant lease or fixed asset portfolio in a high-growth environment

•
Demonstrate strong analytical abilities and comfort working with large, complex datasets

•
Have a track record of improving scalable financial processes in fast-moving environments

•
Have experience mentoring and developing accounting professionals

•
Are adept at translating technical accounting concepts into financial implications for non-finance stakeholders

•
Communicate clearly and influence effectively across cross-functional partners and time zones

•
Have experience partnering with engineering, infrastructure, or operations teams to improve financial reporting and cost transparency

Preferred Requirements:

•
Experience at hyperscalers, large compute consumers, data center operators, or telecommunications companies with exposure to infrastructure lease or asset structures (including colocation, dark fiber IRUs, GPU clusters, networking equipment, and data center buildouts)

•
Experience with lease accounting software and / or fixed asset subledger systems at scale

•
Experience with statutory reporting across multiple jurisdictions, including working with external providers and local audits

•
Experience supporting a US-headquartered multinational from a regional or European finance hub

•
SQL proficiency for querying and analyzing large infrastructure and accounting datasets

•
Background in Big 4 accounting or advisory services combined with industry experience

•
Experience with complex data center buildouts or hybrid cloud / on-premise environments

•
Knowledge of AI/ML infrastructure and associated cost structures

•
Experience applying AI tooling (including Claude) to accounting processes, memo drafting, or close automation

•
Proven ability to navigate ambiguity and drive results in rapidly changing environments

€140.000 — €170.000 EUR

Agent Security's mission is to safely increase how much of the world's work agents can do, starting inside Anthropic.

Claude now writes and ships code, runs experiments and acts on people's behalf, for hours at a time. How much more it can take on depends on how safely it can operate. If, in the worst case, an agent misbehaves, Anthropic and the public may bear the consequences. Our mandate is to mitigate this risk, and Anthropic’s mission depends on it.

The Partnerships team pairs security engineers with the teams at Anthropic that build Claude, build agents and rely on agents. Those teams are our partners. When a team wants its agents to do more, we threat model the plan with them and build the controls together. Most of this has no playbook, so we have often created new controls from first principles. The ones that work become part of our toolbox, spread to other teams, and in some cases ship in our products.

We're hiring an Engineering Manager to lead this team of security engineers. This is first and foremost a people leadership role. Few have secured agents at scale, especially at a frontier lab, so we don't expect you to have done it. We do expect you to have led security engineering teams, and we care most about how you lead people and reason about security.

This role operates at the frontier. Each model generation, and each new harness, brings new challenges. The number of teams building on agents keeps growing, and partner teams won't always agree with your calls. In return, you will have the chance to directly contribute to making transformative AI go well, which is the heart of our mission.

• Balance long-term investment in shared controls against partner teams’ immediate asks

• Deliver large security migrations across all of Anthropic

• Invented a new kind of classifier-based control for agents partnering with an internal team to develop and roll it out

• Co-built a sandbox with a product team, choosing what to enforce first so that adoption stuck

• Defined the security standards for running agents across the company and partnered with many different teams on how to hit these standards

• Experience leading large migrations and highly cross-functional work

• Experience embedding security engineers with product, infrastructure or research teams, or running a security partnerships team

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Claude is trained and served on hardware in data centers Anthropic operates and in sites partners build and run for us. DCSE secures that footprint: the sites, the hardware moving through them, and the people and vendors who touch it. Part of that footprint is the radio spectrum around and inside each site: what transmits there, what listens there, and what the equipment itself gives off. You'll be the engineer who owns that domain end to end: on-site RF monitoring and detection, technical surveillance countermeasures (TSCM) and emanations security, from the threat basis through the systems that make the spectrum observable, to sign-off before a site opens.

The engineering is in the monitoring and in the tooling that proves the controls hold: the sensors, receivers and their placement, the site baselines, and the detection logic that turns a rogue transmitter or an unexpected emitter into an alert an analyst trusts. External specialist partners do the hands-on sweep and measurement work; you write the scope, direct them on site and decide whether their report stands. The goal is security that runs itself: coverage, sensor health and evidence verified continuously, with tools and AI agents doing the routine triage. We favor simple, standard controls and tools that can be verified over elaborate ones. We use Claude throughout our engineering workflow and expect you to as well.

You'll work with the rest of DCSE, including its physical security systems engineers and the engineers on its security monitoring platform, with Anthropic's data center operations, construction and legal teams, and directly with site operators and landlords. The role is based in San Francisco, with remote applicants in the US considered, and involves regular travel to data center sites, which are critical infrastructure.

Key responsibilities

•
On-site RF monitoring and detection: design and develop the monitoring at each site: sensor, receiver and antenna selection and placement, the spectrum monitoring architecture, site RF baselines and what keeps them current, and detections that reach the team's security monitoring platform as alerts analysts keep trusting

•
Tools, automation and AI agents: build the detection and classification tooling, the instruments and software for checks between sweeps, the findings and evidence records behind them, and the agents that triage alerts and watch sensor health. When a review keeps costing people time, you build the tool or agent that retires it

•
Technical surveillance countermeasures: own TSCM end to end: sweep cadence by space sensitivity, event-driven triggers such as fit-out, room turnover or an incident, scope and acceptance criteria per sweep, and findings handled with evidence and closure an assessor accepts

•
Emanations security: set the posture for sites: the assessment method, zoning and separation, and shielding, filtering and protected cabling where warranted, written into the team's design and build standards so a site can build to them and an assessor can verify them

•
Wireless and device policy by zone: detect which radios are actually present where (cellular, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, IoT, trunked radio) and produce the evidence that the policy holds on the floor

•
Specialist partners: write the scope and the deliverable standard for sweep and assessment work, direct it on site, and decide in the acceptance review whether a report stands

•
New sites and leases: carry RF and emanations requirements into design reviews, lease terms and pre-opening reviews, and sign off RF and emanations, including the pre-opening sweep and assessment, before a site opens

Minimum qualifications

•
Have built at least one RF monitoring or detection system end to end, from receiver and antenna choice through the software that turns captures into alerts

•
Understand RF at the engineering level: propagation, modulation, spectrum analysis and antenna behavior, with hands-on use of the instruments that measure them, such as spectrum analyzers and software-defined radios

•
Have planned and conducted TSCM sweeps yourself and can explain, from having done the work, what a sweep can and cannot find and how an adversary would get past it

•
Have done RF security, TSCM or emanations work hands-on for data centers, critical infrastructure or a large hardware fleet

•
Read and review code, design the data systems behind detection and monitoring tooling, and build automation (often with AI coding agents) using Git and code review

•
Understand compromising emanations and what zoning, shielding and filtering each buy and cost, and write requirements for them that a construction team or a landlord can build to and an assessor can test

•
Direct a specialist vendor without deferring to them: write the scope, check the work, reject a weak report

Preferred qualifications

•
Experience assessing compromising emanations and shielding or filtering tradeoffs in a live facility, and applying a formal emanations or counter-surveillance standard, government or commercial (TEMPEST, ICD 705 style construction requirements, or a corporate equivalent)

•
Have built signal classification or spectrum analysis pipelines at scale, or tuned RF detections for a security operations workflow so operators kept trusting them

•
Familiarity with airspace or drone RF detection, and with where it stops and on-site monitoring starts

•
Experience at sites you did not fully control: colocation or multi-tenant facilities, where the RF environment and the walls are not yours alone

•
Have built AI agents or automation that replaced recurring manual security work

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$320,000 — $405,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

body:
About the Opportunity

As our Senior Legal Counsel for Employment Law, you will be the go-to trusted advisor on both individual and collective employment law matters, ensuring compliance with local and EU regulations while supporting diversity and inclusion initiatives. This role manages negotiation strategies and leads complex works council negotiations, reviews employment related agreements, represents the company in employment disputes, and advises on employee relations issues. Additionally, it ensures proper data handling, maintains up to date knowledge of legal developments, and aligns organisational policies with legal requirements and best practices.

In this role you will be responsible for:

•
Strategic Advisory: Provide expert, business-oriented legal counsel on the full spectrum of individual and collective employment law—including employment contracts, compensation structures, terminations, benefits, and anti-discrimination topics.

•
Works Council Partnership: Lead negotiation strategies and build constructive, collaborative relationships with the Works Council to co-create impactful works agreements.

•
Agreements & Documentation: Review employment contracts, offer frameworks, and operational workforce templates, empowering People Operations to move fast while staying compliant.

•
Dispute Resolution & Advocacy: Represent the business in employment-related disputes, proactively defending against claims while protecting our reputation and core values.

•
Employee Relations Support: Advise leadership and people teams on sensitive employee relations topics, from performance management and disciplinary actions to complex grievances.

•
Progressive Policy Design: Shape internal guidelines that champion fairness and comply with local laws, EU directives, and modern Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI) best practices.

•
Employee Data Governance: Safeguard employee trust by ensuring workforce data handling and retention practices remain strictly compliant with GDPR and privacy standards.

•
Future-Proofing & Horizon Scanning: Stay ahead of key legal developments and EU directives, translating regulatory changes into proactive, practical business advantages.

•
Complex Collective Negotiations: Confidently lead the end-to-end negotiation process on nuanced, high-stakes Works Council matters.

What you need to be successful:

•
German qualified lawyer (e.g. German 1. and 2. Staatsexamen).

• Substantial experience practicing German employment law.

• Proven fluency in German co-determination mechanics and a track record of building positive, productive relationships with employee representation bodies (Works Councils).

• Relevant work experience either from a law firm or in-house.

•
Experienced in organisational development and change management and you have a broad understanding of employee relations and employee representation.

Desired Personal Attributes

•
Fluent in both German and English, comfortable negotiating and drafting in both languages.

•
Solutions-driven approach with a knack for translating complex legal nuances into clear, actionable advice that supports business momentum.

•
High emotional intelligence, capable of building seamless relationships across People teams, executive leadership, and employee representatives.

•
Uncompromising ethical standards and calm discretion when managing sensitive matters.

Skills & Competencies

•
Analytical & Drafting Excellence: Strong ability to synthesize legal research into crisp, persuasive, and practical documentation.

•
Negotiation & Tact: Natural conflict-resolution skills with the diplomacy needed to navigate complex human dynamics and reach win-win outcomes.

•
Creative Problem-Solving: Resourceful approach to tackling novel or ambiguous employment challenges.

• Agile Project Management: Structured and organised, with the agility to manage change and deliver high-impact initiatives smoothly.

What’s in it for you:

• Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.

• Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.

• As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.

• Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.

• A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds.

• A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are:

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Madrid and Barcelona, and a 1,700-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

Do you see yourself thriving in this role? We’d love to see your application even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles!

Equal opportunities for all

At N26, we believe our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring. We strive to build diverse teams that drive innovation and business success. We actively seek talent from all backgrounds and welcome applications from all genders, cultures, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages.

We are committed to providing an excellent and accessible candidate experience. If you require any accommodations to make this process work for you, please let us know. We’re here to support you!

Discover more about Diversity & Inclusion at N26: https://n26.com/en-eu/diversity-and-inclusion

🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

Our FinCrime, Fraud & Disputes teams⭐

We are recruiting a Senior Manager to join our FinCrime, Fraud and Disputes team, whilst supporting our Supplier Performance function. Outsourcing is key to enabling Monzo to meet its mission of making money work for everyone, as well as driving a cost efficient operation and delivering excellent customer service.

We are changing how we manage our relationships with our outsourcing partners by driving more responsibility and accountability through our Monzo domain leaders. We need a brilliant Seniors Managers to join this new oversight team, reporting directly to the Directors within each business area.

Partner management is moving right into the heart of our domains. You will be our eyes and ears on the ground, making sure our offshore outsource partners feel like a true extension of Monzo and not just an outsourced supplier. We ensure our partners are set up for success and deliver fantastic customer service.

🔑You’ll play a key role by...

You will act as the vital bridge between Monzo and our external partners to ensure they feel like a true extension of our team. You will drive both operational delivery and a brilliant customer experience. Working closely with our site leaders in South Africa, you will manage day to day service delivery while keeping a close eye on quality, customer satisfaction, and risk management. A key part of your role involves translating our strategic business goals into clear, actionable steps for the partner management team so they are fully equipped to succeed. You will support in domain forecasting and rolling out new processes to make sure they actually work on the floor. Ultimately, you will integrate our partner leaders into our regular performance reviews to foster a genuine one team mindset across the operation.

• Leading a dedicated oversight team: You will directly manage a Supplier Operations Partner who wil focus on Operational Delivery like SLAs, schedule adherence, Customer Experience, quality, and fixing the root causes of repeat contacts.

• Managing the partnership day to day: You will work directly with our outsourced partner Operations Managers to ensure the whole domain is delivering the service, customer satisfaction, quality and risk management we expect.

• Acting as the translation layer: You will turn our strategic business goals into practical, actionable steps for the outsouring management team. You will make sure they are equipped to succeed, rather than just telling them when they miss the mark.

• Tracking and managing performance: You will work alongside our partners to oversee all aspects of day to day service management, including handling risk events and stepping in to engage partners directly when performance drifts.

• Forecasting and planning: Alongside WFM you will raise and approve forecast requests and manage the end to end domain forecasting process for our partners.

• Owning change execution: You will handle the end to end definition and execution of change through our partners, ensuring any new processes or solutions are actually fit for purpose on the floor.

• Integrating the teams: You will support the domain Director to embed Teleperformance leaders into our existing domain performance review meetings, fostering a one team mindset.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

• You have proven track record of working closely with or managing global offshore partners and can manage to a customer experience, not just a commercial contract.

• You are deeply analytical mindset with the ability to anchor decisions in rigorous data, translating complex metrics into robust business cases that secure senior stakeholder buy in.

• You have a proven track record of leading through others and can influence, coach, and guide Managers who do not report directly to you.

• You are brilliant at translating complex business goals into simple steps for frontline teams.

• You zoom out when solving operational problems. Don’t just look at the operational team, always think about how your decisions impact the rest of the business.

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits .

🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps

• Recruiter call (25 minutes)

• Values & Behaviours Interview (60 minutes)

• Role Specific Interview (60 minutes)

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.

#LI-REMOTE #LI-CB4

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog , 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

• Agree routine actions, accountable owners and target dates with partner and internal teams, maintaining clear records and escalating barriers or material delays.

• Maintain the records and supporting evidence from standard operational checks completed during Global Ops partner visits, including practical observations of physical access, desktop security and local control execution.

• Travel periodically to partner locations and independently complete more detailed operational risk reviews, prioritised according to partner criticality, incidents, control concerns and assurance findings.

• Ensure these reviews complement formal TPRM assurance rather than duplicating a full supplier audit, engaging TPRM where specialist advice or formal assurance is required.

• Maintain organised and accessible evidence so Global Ops remains ready for TPRM assessments, second line reviews, Internal Audit, External Audit, compliance assurance and relevant regulatory requests.

Issues, incidents and remediation

• Maintain a complete view of open partner risk issues, control gaps, assurance findings and remediation actions, ensuring owners, dates, dependencies and required closure evidence are clear.

• Own the detailed risk workstream for material partner caused or partner wide incidents, capturing the risk and control implications, coordinating specialist input and maintaining actions through to closure.

• Work with the relevant operational or relationship owner, who will continue to lead the delivery response, while ensuring the associated risks, controls and evidence requirements are fully understood and managed.

• Challenge progress where actions are delayed, the proposed response does not address the underlying risk or closure evidence is insufficient.

• Escalate control failures, missed commitments, repeat issues and barriers to remediation to the Partner Risk Manager and appropriate accountable owner.

• Ensure material incidents, assurance findings and control failures result in appropriate root cause analysis, lessons learned and updates to the relevant risks, controls, contracts, contingency plans or operating practices.

• Apply the standard onboarding and readiness approach rather than creating separate requirements for each partner. Coordinate evidence, identify gaps and track agreed conditions through to completion.

body:
Unter der Aufsicht der BaFin steuert N26 die Interaktionen mit 7 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden in 24 Märkten. Im Rahmen unseres ambitionierten Vorhabens, den Bereich Compliance in diesen Interaktionen weiter zu stärken, schaffen wir eine Position zur federführenden Operationalisierung der regulatorischen Dimension im Austausch mit Kundinnen und Kunden sowie Behörden.

Sie verantworten das Kontrollwesen: Sie konzipieren Kontrollmechanismen, dokumentieren diese und erbringen die Nachweise, die von der Internen Revision, unseren externen Prüfern sowie der Aufsichtsbehörde geprüft werden. Dabei steigen Sie zu einem Zeitpunkt ein, zu dem wesentliche Gestaltungs- und Richtungsentscheidungen noch aktiv getroffen werden – nicht erst im Nachhinein.

Was Sie verantworten

• Die Umsetzungs-Roadmap: jede Maßnahme zu jedem Feststellungspunkt termingerecht konzipiert, dokumentiert, eingeführt und nachgewiesen (Test of Design, Test of Effectiveness).

• Präventive Ursachenanalyse: ein risikobasiertes Verfahren, das Beschwerden nach Auswirkung (finanzieller Schaden, aufsichtsrechtlich, Reputation) auswählt, nicht nur nach Volumen, und sie in Produkt- und Prozessänderungen überführt.

• Die schriftlich fixierte Ordnung des Beschwerdemanagements über alle Märkte: aktuell, konsistent, prüfbar.

• Die laufende Schnittstelle zu Compliance, Risikomanagement, Interner Revision und externen Prüfern für Kontrollen im Beschwerdemanagement.

• Eine Associate-Stelle (Compliance & Prevention) sowie die bereichsübergreifenden Arbeitsstränge mit Produkt, Technik, Legal und Customer Service.

Was Sie mitbringen: drei Dinge

• Deutsch verhandlungssicher (mindestens C1); Englisch fließend.

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon Prüfungs-, Assurance-, IKS- oder Compliance-Tätigkeit in einem regulierten Umfeld: Bank, Zahlungs- oder E-Geld-Institut, Versicherer oder die Prüfungs- und Beratungsgesellschaften, die diese betreuen. Auf welcher Seite des Tisches Sie saßen, ist zweitrangig.

• Sie können eine aufsichtsrechtliche Anforderung in eine dokumentierte Kontrolle übersetzen, einführen und deren Wirksamkeit nachweisen, und Sie haben das unter Prüfungsdruck schon getan.

Hilfreich, nicht Bedingung

• Erfahrung in Beschwerdebearbeitung, Streitbeilegung oder Ombudsverfahren.

• Kenntnis der BaFin-Rundschreiben zum Beschwerdemanagement (MaBeschwer, MaComp BT 12) oder ihrer Entsprechung für Versicherer (Rundschreiben 3/2013 (VA), EIOPA-Leitlinien); PSD2-Fristen.

• Fallbearbeitungs- und BI-Tools (Salesforce, Metabase oder vergleichbar).

• Leitung eines Arbeitsstrangs, Prüfungsteams oder kleinen Teams.

Wer Sie heute sein könnten

Senior Consultant oder Manager in einer Regulatory-Praxis für Finanzdienstleister, der oder die das Ergebnis verantworten will, nicht den Bericht. Interne Revisorin oder Compliance-Beauftragter bei Bank oder Versicherer, die lieber aufbauen als prüfen. Jemand mit Erfahrung in einer Aufsichtsbehörde, der die andere Seite kennenlernen will.

Was wir bieten

• Ein klares Mandat, eine klare Frist und das Budget, es umzusetzen.

• Direkter Kontakt zu Interner Revision, Wirtschaftsprüfern und Aufsicht: die Arbeit, die eine Compliance-Laufbahn ausmacht.

• Berlin, hybrid; Umzugspaket und Visa-Unterstützung bei Bedarf.

• Weiterbildungsbudget, Homeoffice-Budget, Zuschüsse für Fitness, Sprach-Apps und ÖPNV, N26 Premium für Sie und Abos für Familie und Freunde, ein zusätzlicher Urlaubstag pro Beschäftigungsjahr.

About the opportunity

We are looking for an AFC Associate - SAR Writer to join our Italian MLRO Team in Madrid. In this role, you will act as the crucial bridge between first-line operational investigations and regulatory reporting. You will be responsible for reviewing the initial transaction analysis provided by the 1st Line of Defense and drafting high-quality, comprehensive Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs / segnalazioni di operazioni sospette ) for the Italian market.

Working closely with the SAR Delegate and the Italian MLRO, your primary focus will be turning escalated first-line cases into precise, well-structured narratives ready for final validation and submission to the Italian Financial Intelligence Unit (UIF).

In this role, you will:

• Review and challenge the initial alerts analysis, customer profile assessments, and transaction findings escalated by the 1st Line of Defense.

• Draft detailed, structured, and compliant SAR reports, writing the official case narrative and reconstructing the customer’s suspicious behavior according to Italian FIU (UIF) guidelines.

• Identify any analytical gaps or missing documentation in the 1st line escalation and collaborate with operational teams to collect necessary case details before finalizing the draft.

• Prepare finalized draft files alongside clear, evidence-based recommendations for the SAR Delegate and Italian MLRO to facilitate final review, sign-off, and submission.

• Provide feedback to 1st Line of Defense on escalation quality to help align first-line investigative standards with regulatory expectations.

• Support the Italian MLRO team in maintaining organized SAR logs, updating report templates, and compiling data for internal audits and annual regulatory self-assessments.

What you need to be successful:

• University degree in Law, Economics or a related field.

• 1 to 3 years of experience within an Anti-Financial Crime (AFC), AML, or Compliance function (2nd Line of Defense preferred), ideally in a bank, payment institution, or fintech operating in Italy.

• Direct experience or strong familiarity with the SAR/SOS drafting process ( segnalazioni di operazioni sospette ) under the Italian FIU (UIF) regulatory framework.

• Professional certifications (e.g., ICA, ACAMS) are a plus.

• Solid knowledge of Italian AML/CTF regulations (D.Lgs. 231/07) and UIF anomaly indicators/reporting guidelines.

• Fluency in Italian and English (written and spoken) are mandatory.

• Exceptional writting skills (Italian) to craft accurate, formal, and concise narrative reports, with a strong critical eye for reviewing 1st line work.

• Meticulous approach to data consistency, document cross-referencing, and factual accuracy.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Manager – Complaints Operations & Service Delivery to lead the day-to-day complaints operation of N26 across all our markets, with focus on Germany.

Reporting directly to the Head of Customer Service & Complaints Management and Prevention, you will own how the operation performs: regulatory deadlines met in every market, capacity planned rather than improvised, productivity defined and tracked, quality assured and continuity guaranteed.

The complaints market managers report to you; you steer the quality-assurance and workforce-management specialists who support complaints; you work hand in hand with our Compliance & Prevention function, which designs the controls you operate; and you act as designated deputy to the Head of department for complaints operations. This is a hands-on senior operations role in a supervised, high-scrutiny environment — the right job for someone who has turned an operation around on SLAs before and can prove it with numbers.

What You Will Do

• Service Delivery & SLA Ownership: Own regulatory timeliness and backlog across DE/AT, FR, ES, IT and Greater Europe; set queue strategy and prioritisation rules; run the daily and weekly operating rhythm; intervene before thresholds are breached, not after.

• Capacity & Workforce Planning: Own the complaints forecast, staffing model and scheduling, including BPO volume steering; translate volume trends and regulatory changes (e.g. new deadline regimes) into capacity decisions; keep the capacity model current and evidenced.

• Productivity & Operational Excellence: Define productivity standards per market and team, track them monthly, and drive the adoption of optimisation measures — routing, templates, tooling, automation — together with Operational Readiness and our Product & Tech partners.

• Quality Assurance: Run the QA system for complaints output — sampling, calibration across markets, feedback loops, rework reduction — so that quality is measured, not assumed.

• Business Continuity: Own the contingency plan for the complaints operation: triggers, surge playbooks, cross-market and BPO backup, regular tests.

• Team Leadership: Lead, develop and hold accountable the complaints market managers; build operational-management capability in the team; manage performance with facts.

• Evidence & Governance: Produce the operating evidence (reports, sign-offs, exceptions and their handling) that Compliance & Prevention, Internal Audit and external reviewers test; represent complaints operations in management and audit forums and deputise for the Head of department on complaints operations.

What You Will Bring

• Minimal requirements:

• 7+ years in customer or complaints operations in regulated financial services (bank, payment or e-money institution, insurer), including 3+ years leading managers of managers or a multi-site / multi-market operation.

• A demonstrable track record of lifting SLA attainment and productivity in an operation of comparable size (50+ FTE in-house and/or BPO).

• Full professional proficiency in English.

• Background & Experience: Service delivery, workforce management or operational-excellence leadership; experience steering BPO partners on forecast, quality and cost; exposure to audits or regulatory remediation as an operational owner.

• Functional & Technical Knowledge : Forecasting and capacity planning, scheduling, queue and skills-based routing, QA calibration and productivity metrics; practical knowledge of complaint-handling timelines (PSD2 15 / 35 business days, national regimes) and delay-notification duties; case-management and BI tooling (Salesforce, Metabase or equivalent).

• Leadership: Direct, fact-based and calm under scrutiny; able to develop managers who are strong on content into strong operators; comfortable presenting to senior management and auditors.

• Languages: Fluent English required; German or Spanish is a strong plus.

What's in it for you:

• Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe's most innovative banks 🚀.

• Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.

• As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.

• Vacation days vary depending on your location of work. Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.

• A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses.

• A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are?

N26 has reimagined banking for today's digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it's how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

Founded in 2013, N26 now has 7 million customers in 24 markets. We employ more than 1700 employees across 3 office locations in Berlin, Madrid and Barcelona.

Sounds good? Apply now for this position!

N26 is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status.

body:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts , accounts for 16-17 year olds , a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save , invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£108,700 - £140,000 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

Our Financial Crime & Fraud Collective ⭐

We’re all about building trust and keeping our community safe while helping Monzo grow. The Financial Crime & Fraud Collective is at the heart of this work. As a Senior Fraud Risk Manager, you’ll lead the charge in keeping fraudsters at bay so our customers can bank with total confidence!

You’ll get to work across current accounts, business banking, international accounts, and more. While you’ll be managing people and programs, you should also be excited to roll up your sleeves and get hands-on.

We need a crack team of crime fighters to help us stay one step ahead as we continue to grow.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by...

Helping to lead our fast-growing global Fraud & Disputes Risk team and work alongside leaders across our cross-functional Fraud Squads. We’re looking for a proactive, collaborative leader who really knows fraud risk management inside and out - spanning several of our authorised fraud, unauthorised fraud, first-party fraud, and disputes specialisms

You’ll build great relationships with our Product, Engineering, Data, and Operations teams to design smooth, effective fraud controls, investigation processes, and reporting. You’ll also champion a positive team culture and make sure key fraud initiatives stay on track.

Your Core Focus Areas include :

• Fraud Strategy & Operational Execution: Join squad leadership to turn our big-picture fraud vision into practical roadmaps for our UK and EU Banks. You’ll strike the perfect balance between smart protection controls and a seamless customer experience.

• Control Framework & Fraud SME: Be our go-to expert on fraud typologies and prevention tools, overseeing end-to-end design and rollout of strong controls.

• Threat Intelligence & Performance Analytics: Embed data and threat monitoring to catch new fraud trends early, turning insights into quick control improvements.

• Cross-Functional Coordination: Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Ops to keep initiatives aligned and moving forward.

• People Leadership & Capability Building : Coach, mentor, and grow a fantastic fraud risk team while supporting everyone’s personal and professional development.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

• You have strong experience leading fraud strategy and risk teams, ideally in a fast-moving, regulated environment.

• You know UK & EU fraud regulations inside out.

• You’re skilled at building tech-driven fraud strategies that scale across operations.

• You have a proven track record of delivering end-to-end projects and large-scale change programs.

• You stay plugged into industry trends and can quickly respond to new fraud risks.

• You excel at balancing fraud risk with business goals and collaborating to ship new products safely.

• You’re a supportive coach who loves developing high-performing teams.

• You’re an empathetic communicator who aligns messaging with our core values.

• You’re data-driven, comfortable self-serving data, and love using tech to solve problems.

• You hold a relevant industry qualification (such as ICA, Cifas, ACAMS, or CFE).

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £108,700 - £140,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits .

🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps

• 30 min call with the recruiter

• 30 min hiring manager call

• 2 hours of technical and leadership principle interviews

This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.

About the team:

Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and with the planned launch of new initiatives. As our lending portfolio grows, our second line of defence Credit Model Validation team is growing with it - and we’re looking for a Credit Model Validation Manager to join us!

Our Credit Model Validation team provides independent oversight and challenge to our model development teams in the first line of defence. We help Monzo grow safely and make sure the models we use are fit for purpose, appropriately governed and deliver good outcomes for our customers. You’ll join our validation squad and provide expert independent validation and oversight across a broad suite of credit models.

This is a generalist role rather than one focused on a particular model type. You’ll work across models used for impairment, capital, stress testing, forecasting and credit decisioning, including IFRS 9 PD, LGD, EAD and economic response models; decision science scorecards and origination PD models; and Net Present Value (NPV) / unit economics models.

Strong data and analytical skills are a must, as is broad expertise in credit risk modelling and model risk management. You’ll have hands-on experience in model validation and/or development within financial services, and be comfortable getting into the data and code to form an independent view across different model types.

Your day-to-day

• Leading hands-on independent validation across Monzo’s credit model portfolio - covering models used for IFRS 9 impairment, capital and stress testing, forecasting, credit decisioning and unit economics - and making sure they are fit for purpose, appropriately governed and performing as expected

• Reviewing and challenging key model-led credit risk assessments, including impairment adequacy, ICAAP and stress testing, using independent analysis to assess assumptions, limitations and impacts

• Developing a deep understanding of Monzo’s credit models and how they are used, and using this to provide impactful input and challenge to model developers and users

• Contributing to making model validation more consistent, scalable and technology-enabled - building reusable analytical tools and tests, experimenting with AI-assisted approaches and helping the team embed them safely

• Reviewing ongoing model performance monitoring to ensure our lending models perform within our risk thresholds, and providing support to our first line of defence teams when action is required

• Performing statistical analyses, model replication and challenger work where appropriate to test assumptions, assess performance and strengthen validation conclusions

• Improving and helping to embed our Model Risk Framework, including our policies, standards, model inventory, governance and validation approach. This means making sure we follow up-to-date regulatory expectations and that our processes remain proportionate and relevant as modelling techniques evolve

• Writing clear and impactful model validation reports, and presenting the findings and actions in relevant committees

• Partnering with colleagues in first line of defence credit strategy, modelling and finance teams - and with wider risk teams across Monzo - to support effective model governance and consistent validation standards across the organisation

You should apply if you:

• Have a strong background and practical experience in credit model development and/or validation across a range of model types. You’ll have meaningful experience with IFRS 9 impairment, Internal Ratings Based (IRB) or other capital models, alongside broader exposure to several areas such as stress testing, economic response, forecasting, decision science scorecards or NPV / unit economics modelling

• Understand model risk management in practice, including independent validation, model governance, ongoing monitoring, model change and issue management, and how regulatory expectations apply across the model lifecycle

• Are impact-driven and want to improve how validation is done, not only complete individual reviews. You can turn repeatable work into practical methods, tools or guidance that improve quality and consistency across the team.

• Are curious about AI and automation, and can assess where they add value, the risks they introduce, and the controls and human oversight needed. Experience with AI-assisted analytical or coding tools is useful, but not essential

• Are data driven, with strong analytical skills and deep knowledge of statistical techniques for credit and model risk. Strong SQL and Python skills are essential. You can produce clear, reusable and tested code, using collaborative practices such as version control, peer review and documentation. Experience with Tableau, Looker or similar is a plus.

• Can assess models in the context of how they are used - including accounting, capital, credit strategy, risk appetite and customer outcomes - and can distinguish technical model performance from the wider risks of relying on the model

• Have strong written and verbal communication skills, and are able to articulate problems and solutions using clear and simple language. This is particularly important for breaking down complex issues and priorities to non-experts

• Have a track record of building and maintaining trusting relationships with stakeholders at all levels, and can provide effective and respectful challenge

Our technology stack

We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies (note we do not expect applicants to have prior experience of all them):

• Google Cloud Platform for all of our analytics infrastructure

• dbt and BigQuery SQL for our data modelling and warehousing

• Python for data science and machine learning

• Go to write our application code

• AWS for most of our backend infrastructure

The interview process:

Our interview process usually involves up to four main stages via Google Meet:

• An initial call with our recruiter

• A call with our Senior Model Validation Manager, the hiring manager for the role

• A role-specific call with colleagues from our credit modelling and model risk teams. We’ll share a short case study in advance, but you won’t need to submit a written response; we’ll use it to guide the discussion during the interview.

• A behavioural interview

• ⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

• 🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given MacBooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

• ➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits .

⭐Our Tax team

We're looking for an experienced, hands-on and enthusiastic Senior Director of Global Tax to lead the Global Tax team at Monzo, and our wider finance team.

You’ll be leading our growing Tax team of 10+ individuals, and will be reporting into the Group Financial Controller (with a close partnership with the MBL Chief Financial Officer and wider Executive team).

A large part of the role involves advising on the tax implications of all new business developments, ensuring we’re both set up for compliance and optimised wherever possible and appropriate. Given the stage Monzo is currently at in its growth journey, these will be many and wide ranging, from customer products to treasury strategies, group reorgs to mobility proposals, systems implementations to international expansion.

🔑 Key responsibilities of the role...

• Global tax strategy: Defining how Monzo approaches tax across the UK, Europe, and future markets. You will set our tax risk appetite and prepare reporting for our Audit and Risk Committee.

• International expansion: Structuring cross-border expansion across Europe and future regions, advising on market-entry structures, permanent establishment risks, and local compliance.

• Transfer pricing: Establishing, documenting, and defending our global transfer pricing strategy and intragroup financing arrangements.

• Total tax ownership: Overseeing group Direct Tax, Indirect Tax (VAT), Employment Tax, Transfer Pricing, and Operational Customer Taxes across all locations.

• Tax authority relationships: Acting as the primary liaison with HMRC and international tax authorities, proactively managing tax audits, and overseeing statutory regimes including Senior Accounting Officer compliance.

• Product and commercial advisory: Working directly with product managers, engineers, and treasury to understand what they want to build (from savings pots to complex lending products) and ensuring the tax treatment is clear from day one.

• Leading the team: Mentoring and leading our tax team, fostering a culture of technical excellence, autonomy, and commercial focus.

• AI and automation: Designing a tech-enabled tax operating model that embeds AI, workflow tools, and automation across our compliance, reconciliations, and contract reviews; scaling our output as volumes grow while keeping the team focused on high-judgement strategic work.

🤩We’d love to hear from you if...

• You’re a qualified tax professional or accountant (CTA, ACA, ACCA, ADIT, or international equivalent).

• You’ve led an in-house tax team at scale, ideally within banking, fintech, or a regulated multinational.

• You’re an empathetic, effective people leader with a strong track record of coaching individuals and fostering a positive, high-performing environment.

• You bring practical experience with cross-border tax issues, international structuring, and transfer pricing.

• You understand operational and customer taxes common to financial services (such as FATCA/CRS, withholding taxes, and interest reporting).

• You are excited by modern technology, data, and AI, with a clear view on how tools can automate workflows, reduce human error, and modernise routine tax tasks.

• You can explain complex tax positions to non-tax stakeholders, including product leads, commercial teams, and auditors.

• You’re comfortable with ambiguity: we move fast, build things that haven't been built before, and you’ll frequently make calls without a standard blueprint.

• What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!

💰 Dependant on experience + Incentive Awards tied to your performance

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

• Initial Interview with the Hiring Manager (45 min)

• Role Specific, Technical, Leadership & Behavioural Interviews (x4 45 mins)

summary: Senior Analytics Manager - Grow & Engage at N26. Location: Berlin, Germany. A relocation package with visa support for those who need it A relocation package with visa support for those who need it
body:
About the opportunity

You will work in the Grow & Engage domain. This is the heart of the customer experience ranging from the acquisition and signup to our premium membership tiers and the daily engagement of our users. You will work in teams delivering the newest and most innovative features serving our customers in the best way possible.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Analytics Manager to lead the analytics strategy for our Grow & Engage domain, specially focusing on Engagement, Primary Banking, and Subscriptions. You will lead a team of data analysts (up to 7) while personally driving the domain’s most complex strategic and technical areas to solve.

This role is hybrid from Berlin or Barcelona.

Role Breakdown

• 40% Team Leadership & Management: Scale, mentor, and manage the team and develop frontline management talent.

• 40% Strategic IC & Complex Analytics: Personally lead high-stakes analyses on user retention, primary account conversion, and subscription economics.

• 20% Domain Strategy & Data Foundations: Set domain KPIs with senior leadership and scale LLM-driven self-serve analytics foundations.

In this role, you will:

Team Leadership

• Manage & Scale: Lead the team across Engagement, Primary Banking, and Subscriptions, overseeing hiring, performance, and career growth.

• Maintain Rigor: Set high standards for analytical quality, code hygiene, and test design across the domain.

Business & Strategic Impact

• Define Domain Strategy: Partner with Directors/VPs of Product, Marketing, and Growth to align OKRs and shape together the retention and monetization roadmap.

• Primary Banking Loops: Build frameworks that identify key behavioral triggers driving users to adopt us as their primary bank (e.g., direct deposits, recurring payments).

• Subscription Economics: Oversee tier upgrade funnels, LTV modeling, churn prevention, and pricing elasticity for premium memberships.

• Causal Inference: Architect advanced measurement frameworks (uplift modeling, synthetic controls, quasi-experiments).

• Experimentation: Set the right experimentation framework for the whole domain: holdouts, A/B testing, etc.

Data Ecosystem & Community

• Self-Serve & LLM Analytics: Partner with Data Engineering to build scalable data assets and leverage LLM conversational interfaces for self-serve discovery.

• Data Literacy: Run training and workshops to raise data fluency across product and business squads.

• Data Chapter Leader: Contribute to company-wide analytics standards, tooling, and best practices.

What you need to be successful:

Background

• 3+ years of direct people management experience, leading mid-size teams of ICs and/or mentoring frontline managers/leads.

• 7+ years as an individual contributor in analytics/data science within tech or FinTech environments.

• Proven track record of driving revenue, retention, and executive-level product strategy through data.

Skills

• Causal Inference & Experimentation: Expertise in uplift modeling, counterfactuals, synthetic controls, and scaling A/B/n test design.

• Analytics Stack: High proficiency in SQL and Python/R for modeling and statistical analysis.

• Data Storytelling: Modern BI tooling (Looker, Tableau, Metabase, Superset) for executive reporting.

• LLM & Self-Serve: Experience leveraging LLMs to scale self-serve data access.

• Strategic Influence: Confident communicator capable of challenging assumptions and aligning cross-functional leadership.

Nice to Have

• FinTech, neobanking, or subscription product experience.

• Experience scaling analytics teams during high-growth phases.

What's in it for you:

• Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe's most talked about disruptors.

• Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.

• As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.

• Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.

• A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses.

• A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today's digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it's how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Madrid and Barcelona, and a 1,700-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

Sounds good? Apply now for this position.

Equal Opportunities:

We recognize that our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring to our workforce. We strive to build talented and diverse teams to drive our business success and empower our people to reach their full potential.

We genuinely welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages. We're committed to creating an inclusive workspace where everyone feels valued and respected, free from harassment and discrimination. If there's anything you need to make the application process work for you, please let us know by reaching out to candidate.exp@n26.com.

Visit our website to learn more about Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion at N26.

About the opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Lead Technical Product Manager for our Machine Learning Platform within the Intelligent Operations Platforms segment. In this role, you will define the long term vision, platform architecture, and execution strategy for core Machine Learning infrastructure across N26. Your work will enable squads across the bank to automate risk assessments, prevent financial crime, and scale operational efficiency.

Our ML Platforms team serves as the central nervous system for real-time, data-driven decisioning. We build and scale horizontal ML capabilities that allow critical functions including Financial Crime, Credit Risk, and Core Operations to execute with absolute precision at scale. As a Lead Product Manager, you will drive multi-squad strategy, transforming complex predictive models into resilient, compliant, sub-second scoring systems.

In this role, you will

• Drive the Core ML Platform Vision: Define and execute the multi-year roadmap for the central Machine Learning platform, ensuring alignment with broader engineering architecture and executive business goals.

• Lead High-Volume ML Portfolios: Oversee complex predictive ML capabilities supporting high-throughput banking systems, focusing on real-time transaction monitoring, automated credit risk scoring, and operational workflow decisioning.

• Scale Enterprise MLOps Infrastructure: Own the platform tooling and standards across the full ML lifecycle. Drive strategic decisions around feature stores, real-time feature extraction pipelines, model registries, automated retraining triggers, and CI/CD for ML.

• Establish Model Evaluation and Governance: Define robust offline and online model evaluation frameworks, shadow deployment mechanics such as champion and challenger testing, and real-time monitoring for model drift, inference latency, and data quality degradation.

• Bridge Technical Leadership and Compliance: Partner closely with Principal Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Security, and Legal stakeholders to ensure models meet strict European banking governance, explainability, and auditability standards.

• Elevate and Mentor the PM Function: Serve as a functional leader within the product organization. Establish best practices, PRD standards, and self-service ML integration blueprints while mentoring Product Managers in the team.

What you need to be successful

Background & Experience

• 7+ years of Product Management experience in a technology-driven environment, with at least 4 years deeply focused on building, scaling, and managing core Machine Learning platform capabilities or data infrastructure.

• High-Volume B2C Scale: Proven track record of shipping ML products within high concurrency and low latency environments such as FinTech, payment processors, or high-scale consumer tech platforms.

• Strategic & Portfolio Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading multi-squad initiatives, shaping platform strategy across cross-functional engineering triads, and presenting to C-level executives and regulatory bodies.

Technical & Domain Skills

• Deep ML and MLOps Literacy: Hands-on understanding of predictive ML methodologies including classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection, and ranking. This must be paired with architectural mastery of modern MLOps pipelines such as Kafka event streams, feature stores, vector databases, and automated retraining.

• Analytical and Evaluation Rigor: Highly proficient in defining model performance metrics like precision, recall, ROC-AUC, and F1-score, with a clear ability to translate them into business ROI such as reduced false-positive fraud blocks or manual review cost savings.

• Latency and System Trade-Offs: Strong ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between real-time inference and batch scoring, feature compute complexity and latency SLAs, and model accuracy versus explainability.

• Financial Governance and Compliance: Deep understanding of regulatory constraints around automated financial decisioning, model transparency, data privacy under GDPR, and audit trails in regulated environments.

Traits

• Platform Visionary: Ability to abstract domain-specific requirements into reusable horizontal ML services consumed by multiple engineering squads.

• Decisive Technical Leader: Comfortable navigating ambiguity, making high-stakes technical trade-off decisions, and prioritizing foundational infrastructure investments alongside feature delivery.

• Uncompromising Quality Standard: High bar for system resilience, monitoring, and fail-safe mechanisms, recognizing that core banking engines demand 99.99% reliability.

What’s in it for you

• Accelerate your career growth by leading core infrastructure at one of Europe’s premier digital banks.

• Employee benefits including a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, fitness & wellness discounts, and public transportation subsidies.

• A Premium N26 bank account subscription for you, plus subscriptions for friends and family.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500 strong team of more than 80 nationalities.
